name: Håkan Bråkan
summary: The 2003 SVT Christmas calendar is called Håkan Bråkan and is about the mischievous Håkan Bråkan, Sune's little brother. You get to experience an exciting and humorous adventure seen through Håkan's eyes, a bit exaggerated and dramatized. In Håkan's eyes, Dr. Malte is a very evil scientist who keeps Håkan's mother Karin captive in his stress clinic where he performs terrible stress tests. Now you have to help Håkan save his mother Karin so she can get home before Christmas Eve.
